description: This file contains a set of shell script tests for a 'simple command server' using the 'test-lib.sh' framework. It tests the start, communication, response handling, concurrency, and shutdown of an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) server, specifically focusing on a tool called 'simple-ipc'.

methods.name: stop_simple_IPC_server
methods.description: Defines a shell function to stop the simple IPC server by invoking 'test-tool simple-ipc stop-daemon'.
